(One More Time)''' (Japanese: '''VS サワムラー''' ''VS {{tt|Sawamular|Hitmonlee}}'') is the 59th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 19th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{Adv|Green}} and {{p|Jigglypuff}} fly to {{adv|Bill}}'s house and break in by having [[Ditty]] transform into a key. Green tries to tap into the [[Pokémon Storage System]], whilst Bill is asleep and unaware of her. Bill wakes up and mistakes Green for a regular burglar, sending out {{p|Vulpix}} to stop them. Green counters this with [[Blasty]]. Green ties up Bill and his Vulpix, telling him that she believes that he is the Elite Four's next target. She then explains that she was the one helping {{Adv|Yellow}} and Bill when [[Lorelei]] had them cornered. Green tells Bill she'll protect him when the Elite Four come, as long as he lets her see {{Adv|Red}}'s Pokémon data, figuring he'd want to replace [[Pika]]. Bill agrees, and they find out that Red had recently obtained [[Vee]]. They are then attacked by Bruno's Hitmonlee. Hitmonlee tries to flee and Blasty uses {{m|Hydro Pump}} to fly after it, with Green and Bill holding onto its shell. The story ends with Bill asking Green where Yellow is. Green checks a tracking device, showing that Yellow hasn't moved from [[Vermilion City]]. ==Major events== * {{adv|Green}} tries to convince {{adv|Bill}} to let her use his Pokémon Storage System. * Green and Bill are attacked by a {{p|Hitmonlee}}, while {{adv|Yellow}} hasn't left {{ci|Vermilion}} yet. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Vulpix}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Red}} (fantasy) * {{adv|Blue}} (flashback) * {{adv|Green}} * {{adv|Yellow}} * {{adv|Bill}} * [[Lorelei]] (fantasy) * [[Agatha]] (fantasy) * [[Bruno]] (fantasy) * [[Lance]] (fantasy) ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Poliwrath}} ([[Poli]]; {{adv|Red}}'s; fantasy) * {{p|Venusaur}} ([[Saur]]; {{adv|Red}}'s; flashback) * {{p|Snorlax}} ([[Snor]]; {{adv|Red}}'s; fantasy) * {{p|Gyarados}} ([[Gyara]]; {{adv|Red}}'s; fantasy) * {{p|Aerodactyl}} ([[Aero]]; {{adv|Red}}'s; fantasy) * {{p|Charizard}} ({{OP|Blue|Charizard}}; flashback) * {{p|Jigglypuff}} ([[Jiggly]]; {{adv|Green}}'s) * {{p|Blastoise}} ([[Blasty]]; {{adv|Green}}'s) * {{p|Ditto}} ([[Ditty]]; {{adv|Green}}'s) * {{p|Raticate}} ([[Ratty]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Doduo}} ([[Dody]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Pika]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Graveler}} (Gravvy; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Omanyte}} ([[Omny]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Caterpie}} ([[Kitty]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Vulpix}} ({{adv|Bill}}'s) * {{p|Hitmonlee}} ([[Bruno]]'s) * {{p|Ho-Oh}} ({{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Ho-Oh|Adventures}}; flashback) ==Trivia== * This chapter's English title is a pun on the {{wp|Britney Spears}} song {{wp|...Baby One More Time (song)|...Baby One More Time}}. ===Errors=== * In the {{pmin|Brazil|Brazilian Portuguese translation}}, [[Bill]] incorrectly calls {{adv|Green}} by her Japanese name "Blue". ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{yellow color light}}|bordercolor={{yellow color}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 沙瓦郎|VS Hitmonlee}} |cs=Vs.
